extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp used for?
faqs.a: A cable anchor restraint clamp fixes a steel safety cable to treating iron during high-pressure pumping, to restrain the line if a joint fails. This forged-steel clamp is matched to 4-inch treating iron OD, with an eye-style termination for the cable.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp come in?
faqs.a: This listing is the 4-inch treating iron OD clamp. Other OD sizes, 2-inch, 3-inch and 5-inch, are available on request. Match the clamp to the tube OD of your treating iron.

faqs.q: What cable does the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp accept?
faqs.a: The eye-style termination accepts a steel safety cable in line with API standards for pumping-iron whip-restraint. Select the cable size and rating to suit the line and the pressure.

faqs.q: What is the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp made from?
faqs.a: It is forged steel, with a NACE MR-0175 material option on request. State the sour-service requirement on the RFQ if the fluid contains H2S.

faqs.q: What operations is the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp specified for?
faqs.a: It is a pressure-pumping spec sized for cementing, stimulation, fracturing and well-testing line restraint. Choose it wherever treating iron is run under high pressure.

faqs.q: What does the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp fit on?
faqs.a: It fits 4-inch treating iron elements, such as pipe and fittings in the flow line, matched on the tube OD. See [flow iron flow line](/c/flow-iron-flow-line), [flow iron fittings](/c/flow-iron-fittings-suppliers-uae) and [hammer unions](/c/hammer-unions-sour-gas-service).

faqs.q: How does a cable anchor clamp differ from a whip check?
faqs.a: A restraint clamp fixes a safety cable at a point on the iron, so a failed joint cannot whip freely. See the guide [flow iron explained](/blog/flow-iron-explained) for how restraint fits in a flow-iron system.

faqs.q: Where is the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp used?
faqs.a: It is used on treating iron during cementing, stimulation, fracturing and well testing, wherever a pressurised line needs whip restraint.

faqs.q: How should a cable anchor restraint clamp be installed?
faqs.a: Fit the clamp on the tube OD it is sized for, run the steel safety cable through the eye termination, and anchor the cable to a fixed point. Follow your operator and site safety procedures.

faqs.q: What should I send for a restraint clamp quotation?
faqs.a: Send the treating iron OD (2-inch, 3-inch, 4-inch or 5-inch), the quantity, the safety cable size and the sour-service requirement.

faqs.q: Can the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp be supplied in other sizes?
faqs.a: Yes. Other OD sizes, 2-inch, 3-inch and 5-inch, are available on request. Send the tube OD of the treating iron you run and the quantity, and the clamp is quoted to match.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 4-inch treating iron cable anchor restraint clamp as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send your configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
